crossRefs.note: Joseph hurried, for his heart yearned over his brother; and he sought a place to weep. He entered into his room, and…
In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he…
When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,
Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all…
On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword…
“Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.
On some have compassion, making a distinction,
and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.

people.name: Simeon
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, one of the twelve tribes.

translations.web: He turned himself away from them, and wept. Then he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.
translations.bsb: And he turned away from them and wept. When he turned back and spoke to them, he took Simeon from them and had him bound before their eyes.
translations.kjv: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.
translations.asv: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and he returned to them, and spake to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.
